title: Meta Whistleblower Sues Company Over Alleged Attempt to Silence Memoir ‘Careless People’
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: Former Meta executive Sarah Wynn-Williams has filed a lawsuit accusing the company of unlawfully attempting to silence her following her memoir Careless People, which details allegations about Facebook’s internal culture and leadership.

title: Oracle Beats Revenue Estimates as AI-Driven Cloud Growth Accelerates
author: Emily Rodriguez
excerpt: Oracle exceeded fourth-quarter revenue expectations as cloud infrastructure demand surged, but investors focused on the company's growing AI-related spending and ambitious data center expansion plans.

title: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary Signs New Contract With Potential £130M Payout
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary has extended his contract with the airline in a performance-linked agreement that could earn him more than £130 million if key targets are achieved.

title: A Gift of Movement: Britannia Financial Group, Serpentine and the Public Legacy of Jesús Rafael Soto
author: Business Desk
excerpt: Britannia Financial Group supports Jesús Rafael Soto’s Pénétrable BBL Jaune at Serpentine South, bringing a landmark work of kinetic art into Kensington Gardens.

title: Apollo Launches £5.7 Billion Takeover Offer for easyJet, Outbidding Rivals
author: Jessica Wu
image: /images/news/Global Markets Slide as Oil Surges on Escalating Gulf Conflict.webp
excerpt: Apollo Global Management has made a surprise £5.7 billion takeover bid for easyJet, offering a higher price than rival bidder Castlelake and potentially reshaping Europe's airline industry.

title: How Crypto Billionaires Are Creating Governance Systems Where Money Buys Votes
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Crypto Billionaires Are Building Communities Where Wealth Determines Voting Power.webp
excerpt: Crypto billionaires are backing blockchain governance systems that give voting rights based on token ownership, raising questions about whether wealth should determine influence in digital communities.

title: SK Hynix Unveils $28 Billion U.S. Listing on Nasdaq to Capitalize on AI Boom
author: Michael Chen
image: /images/news/South Korea’s SK Hynix Launches Massive U.S. Nasdaq Listing as AI Chip Demand Soars.webp
excerpt: South Korean semiconductor giant SK Hynix is launching a roughly $28 billion listing on the Nasdaq, one of the largest share sales globally, aimed at broadening investor access and tapping AI driven demand for memory chips.

title: OpenAI Executive Fidji Simo Steps Down From Full-Time Role, Moves to Advisory Position
author: Emily Rodriguez
image: /images/news/OpenAI Executive Fidji Simo Steps Down From Full-Time Role, Moves to Advisory Position.webp
excerpt: OpenAI executive Fidji Simo is stepping down from her full-time leadership role and transitioning to a part-time advisory position after an extended medical leave, marking another major leadership change at the AI company.
